classes.lumpNote: Riley's and Cassin's 13-year cicadas are lumped. Choruses of the two often occur together and are hard to separate from a phone mic.
Lesser and greater anglewings are lumped. Both make sparse high ticks, and the lesser anglewing has very few recordings.
Handsome and red-headed meadow katydids are lumped. Both have thin high songs and only a few commercial-safe recordings.
Broad-winged and prairie tree crickets are lumped. Their trills are very similar, and the prairie tree cricket has only a handful of commercial-safe recordings.
